title: Understanding artifact (contract 1.0.0)
description: Canonical JSON document of the understanding phase artifact. Generated by the phase LLM and submitted via the factory_understanding_submit tool; validated here before any persistence. understanding.md is a deterministic render of this document and is never the source of truth.

sourcePrompt.description: The original prompt (the change description) VERBATIM. It is rendered into the 'Original Prompt' section of understanding.md inside a code fence and must exactly match the change description recorded by the extension.

intent.description: Interpreted intent of the original prompt.

objective.description: The primary objective as interpreted from the prompt.

expectedOutcome.description: The expected end state or outcome if the objective is achieved.

successIndicators.description: Observable indicators that the outcome was achieved.

explicitInformation.description: Information explicitly stated in the original prompt (goals, constraints, preferences, decisions). Empty when the prompt states nothing checkable.

inferences.description: Conclusions inferred (not stated) from the prompt. Each must cite evidence and carry an auditable rationale — never hidden chain-of-thought.

scope.description: Scope boundaries derived from the prompt. Unstated functionality belongs in 'undetermined', never in 'outOfScope' without evidence.

inScope.description: Items the prompt puts in scope.

outOfScope.description: Items with supporting evidence that they are out of scope.

undetermined.description: Items whose scope remains undetermined (not asserted out of scope).

ambiguities.description: Ambiguous statements and open questions. An unresolved ambiguity must not silently become a confirmed requirement.

candidateRequirements.description: CANDIDATE requirements derived from the prompt. The formal requirement phase remains responsible for the authoritative requirement artifact; these candidates only inform it.

summary.description: Concise summary of the current interpretation.

narrative.description: Concise summary of the interpreted intent and important conclusions.

unresolvedIssues.description: Important unresolved issues (should align with open ambiguities).

clarificationsNeeded.description: Decisions or clarifications required from the user before or during the requirement phase.

traceability.description: Traceability links. Never reference artifacts that do not yet exist.

sourcePromptRef.description: Authoritative reference to the immutable source input (e.g. the change description of this change).

relatedArtifactRefs.description: References to pre-existing artifacts consulted during understanding (empty when none exist).

items.description: One reference to an existing artifact.

requirementRefs.description: Downstream requirement references; empty until the requirement phase produces them.

items.description: One requirement record id (REQ-###) that consumes this understanding.

metadata.description: Machine-identifiable provenance of this understanding document.

artifactType.description: Must equal the contract's artifact type.

contractVersion.description: Semantic version of the understanding contract this document follows.

changeId.description: The factory change id this understanding belongs to; must match the active change.

revision.description: Revision number the extension will record for this candidate (take the expected revision from the phase prompt).

status.description: complete only when the interpretation is ready for validation and review.

sourcePromptRef.description: Authoritative reference to the source prompt this interpretation was derived from.

explicitEntry.description: One piece of information explicitly stated in the original prompt.

statement.description: The explicitly stated information, in the user's terms.

sourceRef.description: Where in the original prompt this is stated (quote or location).

inferenceEntry.description: One inferred conclusion or assumption, kept distinct from explicit statements.

evidence.description: The prompt text, repository fact, or artifact entry supporting the inference.

rationale.description: Concise, auditable rationale for the inference (not hidden chain-of-thought).

impactIfWrong.description: Consequence if this inference turns out to be incorrect.

status.description: open until the user confirms or rejects it; confirmed/rejected only with a recorded basis.

outOfScopeEntry.description: One out-of-scope item with the evidence that justifies the classification.

item.description: The item classified as out of scope.

evidence.description: The prompt statement or artifact evidence supporting the out-of-scope classification. Unstated functionality must NOT be listed here.

ambiguityEntry.description: One ambiguity or open question from the original prompt.

question.description: The unresolved question or ambiguous statement.

interpretations.description: Plausible interpretations of the ambiguous statement.

impact.description: Impact on the change if the wrong interpretation is chosen.

status.description: open while unresolved; resolved only when the user decided.

resolution.description: How the ambiguity was resolved (required when status is resolved).

candidateEntry.description: One candidate requirement believed to derive from the prompt (candidates only — the requirement phase produces the authoritative requirement artifact).

id.description: Stable local candidate id, e.g. CR-001.

origin.description: Whether the candidate derives from an explicit prompt statement or from an inference.

sourceRefs.description: References the candidate derives from: ids of explicit entries, inferences, or ambiguities in this document, and/or the literal token 'prompt'.

relatedIds.description: Related assumptions or open questions in this document that bear on the candidate.
